description: Strip markers in a heredoc are applied to its literals in the parse tree
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The line feed U+000A has the White_Space property but is not a space separator (category Zs), and hclsyntax/spec.md says newline sequences are not whitespace. Stripping it is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
